title: Drywhisker Gorge
wikitext:
[[Image:Drywhisker Gorge.jpg|thumb|Drywhisker Gorge]]
A gorge cutting through the mountains of eastern [[Arathi Highlands]], near [[Hammerfall]]. At the end of the gorge lies a cave, which is the only known source of [[Bloodstone]] ore. It's currently inhabited by [[Kobold|Kobolds]]. Deep within the cave, a mysterious stone shard can be found, in which a piece of essence of princess [[Myzrael]] was trapped.
